## Change

Explain the problem and behavior change. Link the issue/discussion.

## Verification

List exact commands and actual results. Clearly mark unrun checks.

## Scope and safety

- [ ] Tests use labelled synthetic inputs or explicitly described non-private fixtures.
- [ ] No credentials, account data, market captures, databases or private runtime exports.
- [ ] No implicit broker connection or change to human Issue authority.
- [ ] Source identity, causality, freshness and unavailable states remain honest.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility notes updated where applicable.
- [ ] Third-party sources and rights are identified when introducing new material.
